column1: # bus14, difficulty 0, branch dev/fixed-async (upstream PR #7 fixes + async PPO). Seeds are appended by run_queue.py.
# slots: CPU share on a 32-vCPU VM (max-slots 4). Async PPO and vanilla runs keep all 50 workers busy -> 2;
#        sync heuristic runs (DQN/SAC) are straggler-bound and mostly idle -> 1.
# budgets: vanilla / redispatch 2M agent steps; heuristic (I/R) 500k agent steps (each spans many grid steps).
# eval: --eval-freq 50000 (2M runs) / 25000 (500k runs); defaults (PPO 10k, DQN 500, SAC/TD3 1k) make the
#       single-threaded in-process evaluation dominate once episodes get long (up to 8064 steps x 3 episodes).
